lines.note: 卢旺达语字母分为三组: 五个元音，两个半元音（半辅音）和十七个辅音。
在卢旺达语中，多个辅音可以结合在一起，或者辅音可以与半元音结合形成复合辅音。复合辅音可以由两个或三个辅音组成，也可以与一个或两个半元音结合。本书重点学习由两个辅音组成，或由一个辅音加一个半元音组成的、在卢旺达语词汇中非常常用的复合辅音。
注：只有在 Kabgayi 这个词中，bw 被写成 bg。
卢旺达语有 5 个元音：i, u, o, a, e；17 个辅音：b, c, d, f, g, h, j, k, m, n, p, r, l, s, t, v, z；2 个半元音：y, w。在卢旺达语中，复合辅音可以由两个或三个辅音组成，也可以与一个或两个半元音结合，发成一个音节。例如：nd, ntw, nshw, nshyw。

lines.tts: Waramutse ho nawe?, Mwaramutse ho namwe?
Wiriwe ho nawe?, Mwiriwe ho namwe?, Yego.
Uririrwe ho, Wirirwe ho, Mwirirwe ho!

lines.rw: Uririrwe (ho) nawe / Wirirwe (ho) nawe / Mwirirwe (ho) namwe / Yego.
lines.tts: Uririrwe ho nawe, Wirirwe ho nawe, Mwirirwe ho namwe, Yego.
Uraramuke ho, Uramuke ho, Muramuke ho!

lines.rw: Uraramuke (ho) nawe / Uramuke (ho) nawe / Muramuke (ho) namwe / Yego.
lines.tts: Uraramuke ho nawe, Uramuke ho nawe, Muramuke ho namwe, Yego.

lines.note: 在卢旺达文化中，问候语可以分为单数和复数形式。复数形式的问候语既可以表示复数（对多人），也可以表示尊敬。例如：
打招呼时，人们可以互相拥抱或握手。拥抱代表爱，也表达了因长期分离而产生的思念。在卢旺达文化中，即使互不相识，向遇到的人打招呼也是一个好习惯。问候和道别的形式会根据时间而有所不同。

lines.zh: 早晨问候：早上好？/ 天亮得怎样？/ 你们看到天亮了吗？
lines.tts: Waramutse ho?, Mwaramutse ho?, Bwakeye bute?, Mwabonye bucya?

lines.zh: 早晨道别：祝你有美好的一天 / 愿你度过和平的一天
lines.tts: Wirirwe ho, Mwirirwe ho, Wiriranwe amahoro.

lines.zh: 中午问候：下午好？/ 愿你们度过和平的下午？
中午道别：祝你下午愉快
晚上道别：晚安，明天见，再见（当很久之后才会再次相见时）

lines.note: 还有一些祝愿某人好运和繁荣的问候语：

lines.zh: 回答：是的 / 我感谢他 / 我认同你的祝福。
回答：是的 / 我感谢她 / 我认同你的祝福。

lines.note: “(M)uraho”（你好）用于当你第一次见到某人，或者当你很久没有见到他/她时。
今天是开学的第一天，同学们都要作自我介绍。一位名叫乌瓦玛丽亚（Uwamariya）的年轻女学生简短地介绍了自己。

lines.zh: 我叫乌瓦玛丽亚，我是一名新生。
lines.en: My name is Uwamariya. I am a new student.

lines.zh: 我父亲是克劳德·穆塔巴齐。
我有一个兄弟，他叫查尔斯·塞巴希雷。
lines.rw: Mfite umuvandimwe umwe. Izina rye ni Sebahire Karori.
lines.en: I have one brother. His name is Sebahire Charles.

lines.note: 穆卡穆索尼（ Mukamusoni ）和纳马霍罗（Namahoro）在大学图书馆相遇。穆卡穆索尼向纳马霍罗打招呼并做了自我介绍。

lines.zh: 我叫纳马霍罗。你呢，你叫什么名字？
lines.en: My name is Namahoro. And you, what's your name?

lines.zh: 我住在大学校园里。你住在哪里？
lines.rw: Mba hano kuri Kaminuza. Wowe se uba he?
lines.en: I live here at university campus. Where do you live?
I live in a guest house.

lines.note: 尼约伊塔（Niyoyita）、穆根齐（Mugenzi）、塞贝拉（Sebera）和鲁巴伊塔（Rubayita）初次见面。他们开始聊天，每个人都向其他人做自我介绍。

lines.rw: Nge (we) nitwa Mugenzi. Wowe izina ryawe ni irihe?
lines.en: My name is Mugenzi. And you?
lines.tts: Nge we nitwa Mugenzi. Wowe izina ryawe ni irihe?

lines.zh: 那个年轻人叫什么名字？
lines.en: What is the name of that young man?
What are the names of those ones?

lines.zh: 他们的名字是加钦亚和桑武拉。
lines.en: Their names are Gacinya and Samvura.

lines.rw: Izina ryawe ni irihe? Witwa nde?

lines.zh: 我的名字是 X。/ 我叫 X。
lines.rw: Izina ryange ni X. Nitwa X
Izina rye ni irihe? Yitwa nde?
Izina rye ni X. Yitwa X.

lines.note: 布维扎（Bwiza），一个卢旺达女孩，遇到了布隆迪人卡米卡齐（Kamikazi），并互相交谈。

lines.zh: 我叫布维扎。你呢，你叫什么名字？
lines.rw: Nge nitwa Bwiza. Wowe se witwa nde?
lines.en: My name is Bwiza. And you, what is your name?

lines.zh: 我来自布隆迪。我是布隆迪人（女）。
lines.en: I come from Burundi. I am Burundian.

lines.zh: 我来自卢旺达。我是卢旺达人（女）。
lines.rw: Nge nkomoka mu Rwanda. Ndi Umunyarwandakazi.
lines.en: I come from Rwanda. I am Rwandan.

lines.note: 注意在卢旺达语中，国籍名称始终以字母 umu- 或umunya- 开头。当该人是女性时，我们在国籍名称的
把国籍名称变成复数形式很简单。首字母部分umu- 或 umunya- 将被替换为 aba-。

lines.rw: Ni meza. Aba muri kumwe ni bande?
lines.en: I am fine. Who are these friends?

lines.zh: 这是我住在肯尼亚的兄弟。而这位是我的表亲。
lines.rw: Uyu ni musaza wange uba muri Kenya. Naho uyu we ni mubyara wange wo kwa marume.
lines.en: This is my brother who lives in Kenya. And this one is my cousin.

lines.zh: 很高兴认识他们。我没有舅舅，我只有姑姑和姨妈。
lines.rw: Ndabishimiye. Nge nta marume ngira. Mfite masenge na mama wacu gusa.
lines.en: I am happy to know them. Me, I don't have any uncle but I only have aunties.

lines.zh: 我有一个姐姐和一个妹妹。
lines.rw: Mfite mukuru wange umwe na murumuna wange umwe.
lines.en: I have one elder sister and one young sister.

lines.zh: 但是我去你家的时候怎么没看到你姐姐？
lines.rw: Ko naje iwanyu mukuru wawe simubone?
lines.en: But when I came to your home I didn't see your elder sister.

lines.zh: 她和我们在卢汉戈的祖父祖母住在一起。
lines.rw: Abana na sogokuru na nyogokuru mu Ruhango.
lines.en: She lives with our grandfather and grandmother in Ruhango.

lines.zh: 很好！再见！代我向你的父母和妹妹问好。
lines.rw: Ni byiza. Urabeho, usuhuze ababyeyi na murumuna wawe.
lines.en: Nice! Good bye! Greetings to your parents and young sister.

lines.zh: 姐夫/妹夫/大伯子/小叔子
嫂子/弟媳/大姑子/小姑子
这不是你第七次去肯尼亚了吗？
lines.rw: Ubu si nk'ubwa karindwi ugiye muri Kenya?
lines.en: Isn't it the seventh time you travel to Kenya?

lines.rw: Iyi nshuro ni iya cumi na kabiri.

lines.zh: 请问你能帮我买一块手表、一部手机和一台电视机吗？
lines.en: Please, can you buy for me a watch, a telephone and a TV set?

lines.zh: 手表六千，手机八万，电视机三十万。我全部帮你买吗？
lines.rw: Isaha igura ibihumbi bitandatu, terefone ibihumbi mirongo inani, tereviziyo ibihumbi magana atatu. Nzabikugurire?
lines.en: The price of a watch is six thousand, eighty thousand for a telephone and three hundred thousand for a TV set. Can I buy all of them for you?
Yes, you can. See you later.

lines.rw: Ibihumbi magana abiri na mirongo ine

lines.note: 在卢旺达语中，从一数到十时，umunani（八）、ikenda（九）、icumi（十）的形式不发生变化。

lines.zh: 跟你在一起的这个孩子几岁了？
lines.rw: Uwo mwana muri kumwe afite imyaka ingahe?
lines.en: How old is this child with you?
Are you of the same age as Higaniro?

lines.zh: 希加尼罗比我年轻。他三十五岁。
lines.rw: Higaniro ni we muto. Afite imyaka mirongo itatu n'itanu.
lines.en: Higaniro is younger than I. He is thirty five old.
I am the youngest of the family.
I am the eldest of the class.

lines.note: 当你想询问年龄时，可以使用以下句子：
回答时说：mfite imyaka...（我……岁），afite imyaka...（他/她……岁），dufite imyaka...（我们……岁），bafite imyaka...（他们……岁）。

lines.zh: 你的婚礼筹备得怎么样了？
我正在准备。我希望你能帮我。我们星期四要去登记。
lines.rw: Ndi mu myiteguro yabwo. Nifuzaga ko uyimfashamo. Dore ku wa Kane tuzajya gusezerana imbere y'amategeko.
lines.en: I am doing my preparations and I want you to help me. We have our civil marriage on Thursday.

lines.zh: 我随时准备帮你。婚礼仪式什么时候举行？
lines.rw: Niteguye kukuba hafi. Gusezerana imbere y'Imana ni ryari?
lines.en: I am ready to help you. When will religious marriage take place?

lines.zh: 婚礼仪式将在 2016 年 12 月 12 日星期六上午十一点举行，下午两点在我们区的多功能厅接待宾客。
lines.rw: Gusezerana imbere y'Imana bizaba ku wa Gatandatu tariki ya 12 Ukuboza 2016 saa tanu za mugitondo, abatumiwe bakakirwa saa munani mu nzu mberabyombi y'Umurenge wacu.
lines.en: Our religious marriage will take place on Saturday December 12, 2016 at eleven o'clock. The reception is scheduled at two o'clock pm in our Sector hall.
lines.tts: Gusezerana imbere y'Imana bizaba ku wa Gatandatu tariki ya cumi n'ebyiri Ukuboza ibihumbi bibiri na cumi na gatandatu saa tanu za mugitondo, abatumiwe bakakirwa saa munani mu nzu mberabyombi y'Umurenge wacu.

lines.zh: 我得走了，下个星期天我会回来和你敲定最后的准备工作。
lines.rw: Reka ngende, nzagaruka ku Cyumweru gitaha tunoze gahunda.
lines.en: I have to leave now but I will be back on next Sunday to finalize with you the last preparations.

lines.zh: 非常感谢。祝你有美好的一天！
lines.en: Thanks a lot. Have a nice day!

lines.note: 当时间超过整点几分钟时，先说小时，再加分钟。/ Iyo hari iminota irenga ku isaha, uvuga ahera ku isaha akongeraho iminota irengaho.

lines.zh: 14:30: 下午两点三十分（两点半）
lines.rw: saa munani n'iminota mirongo itatu / saa munani n'igice
lines.en: It's thirty minutes past two pm.
lines.tts: saa munani n'iminota mirongo itatu, saa munani n'igice

lines.zh: 7:45: 七点四十五分（差一刻八点）
lines.rw: saa moya n'iminota mirongo ine n'itanu; saa mbiri zibura iminota cumi n'itanu
lines.en: It's forty five minutes past seven; It's a quarter to eight.

lines.note: 在卢旺达语中，表示半小时（30 分钟）时，可以使用“n'iminota mirongo itatu（过三十分钟）”或“n'igice（半）”。必须通过添加“z'amanywa（白天）”或“z'ijoro（夜晚）”来指明是白天还是晚上的时间。当时间超过三十分钟时，可以通过说差几分钟到下一个小时来表示时间。
注意：在卢旺达语中，说星期几时，前面会加上“ku wa”，然后是从一到六的数字，除了星期日（icyumweru）前面只加“ku”（ku cyumweru）。星期六也被称为“Isabato”（安息日），主要是基督复临安息日会的信徒这样称呼，所以“在星期六”可以说成“ku isabato”。

lines.zh: 在卢旺达语中，白天的时间从早上七点开始，到下午六点结束。
lines.rw: Mu Kinyarwanda amasaha y'umunsi atangirira kuri saa moya (7:00) akarangira saa kumi n'ebyiri.
lines.en: The day hours in Kinyarwanda begin at 7:00 am (saa moya za mugitondo) and end at 6:00 pm (saa kumi n'ebyiri za nimugoroba).
lines.tts: Mu Kinyarwanda amasaha y'umunsi atangirira kuri saa moya akarangira saa kumi n'ebyiri.

lines.zh: 在卢旺达语中，一周有七天。
lines.rw: Mu Kinyarwanda hari iminsi y'icyumweru irindwi.

lines.en: There are twelve months in a year.

lines.zh: 卢旺达有四个季节：大雨季、小旱季、大旱季、小雨季。
lines.rw: Mu Kinyarwanda hari ibihe bine by'umwaka: Itumba, Urugaryi, Iki, Umuhindo.
lines.en: We have four seasons in Kinyarwanda: Itumba, Urugaryi, Iki, Umuhindo.

lines.zh: 你能告诉我卢旺达在非洲的什么位置吗？
lines.rw: Mwambwira aho Igihugu cy'u Rwanda giherereye muri Afrika?
lines.en: Would you like to indicate me where is Rwanda in Africa?

lines.zh: 卢旺达位于中非，与四个国家接壤。
lines.rw: U Rwanda ruherereye muri Afrika yo hagati, ruhana imbibi n'ibihugu bine.
lines.en: Rwanda is located in central Africa, with four neighboring countries.

lines.zh: 北边是乌干达，南边是布隆迪，西边是刚果民主共和国，东边是坦桑尼亚。
lines.rw: Mu majyaruguru yarwo hari u Bugande, mu magepfo hari u Burundi, iburengerazuba hari Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo naho iburasirazuba hari Tanzaniya.
lines.en: Uganda is in North, Burundi is in South, Democratic Republic of Congo is in West and Tanzania is in East.

lines.zh: 啊！我明白了，我去过坦桑尼亚。谢谢！
lines.rw: Ahaaa! Ndumva nsobanukiwe kuko nageze muri Tanzaniya. Murakoze!
lines.en: Ah! I see. I have been in Tanzania. Thanks!

lines.note: 在卢旺达语中，当人们指路或问路时，会使用这些词语：
其他常用词汇包括：
卢旺达人指路时，通常会给出一个靠近目的地的总体位置或著名的公共场所（如学校、市场、医院等），然后要求那个人到了那里之后再问路。如今，人们也会使用路标。

lines.zh: 谢谢！请问你能给我推荐一些旅游景点吗？我姐姐和她的美国丈夫要来卢旺达，他们希望能参观一些地方。
lines.rw: Murakoze. Nagira ngo undangire ahantu nyaburanga. Mukuru wange azazana n'umugabo we w'Umunyamerika mu Rwanda kandi bifuza gutaha bagize aho basura.
lines.en: Thank you! Would you like to indicate me some tourist sites. My grand sister and her American husband will come to Rwanda and wish to visit some of them.

lines.zh: 卢旺达最常被参观的旅游景点是国家公园、博物馆、湖泊和天然森林。
lines.rw: Ahantu nyaburanga hasurwa cyane mu Rwanda ni amapariki y'Igihugu, Inzu Ndangamurage, ibiyaga n'amashyamba ya kimeza.
lines.en: The most visited tourist sites in Rwanda are National parks, museums, lakes and natural forests.

lines.zh: 这些旅游景点在哪里？在那里能看到什么？
lines.rw: Aho hantu nyaburanga haherereye he? Wahasura iki?
lines.en: Where are those tourist sites and what can people find there?

lines.zh: 卢旺达北部有生活着山地大猩猩的火山国家公园。东部有生活着狮子、水牛、鹤等的阿卡盖拉国家公园。西南部有生活着猴子和美丽树木的纽恩威国家公园。在基加利市、胡耶和尼安扎区有博物馆。
lines.rw: Mu majyaruguru y'u Rwanda hari Pariki y'ibirunga ibamo ingagi. Mu burasirazuba hari Pariki y'Akagera ibamo intare, imbogo, imisambi n'ibindi. Mu magepfo y'iburengerazuba hari Pariki ya Nyungwe ibamo inguge n'ibiti byiza. I Kigali, i Huye n'i Nyanza hari Inzu Ndangamurage.
lines.en: In the north of Rwanda there is Volcanoes National Park where live Mountain gorillas. In the east there is Akagera National Park where live lions, buffaloes, cranes etc. In the south- west there is Nyungwe National Park where we can find monkeys and beautiful trees. In Kigali City, in Nyanza and in Huye districts there are museums.

lines.zh: 你说的那些湖泊在哪里？
lines.en: Where are the lakes you talked about?

lines.zh: 穆哈齐湖在东部，基伍湖在西部，北部有布雷拉湖和鲁洪多湖。
lines.rw: I Burasirazuba hari ikiyaga cya Muhazi, i Burengerazuba hari ikiyaga cya Kivu, mu majyaruguru hakaba ibiyaga bya Burera na Ruhondo.
lines.en: The lake Muhazi is in the East, the lake Kivu is in the West and in the North there are Burera and Ruhondo lakes.

lines.zh: 非常感谢。我稍后会通知她。
lines.en: Thanks a lot. I will inform her later.

lines.zh: 卢旺达有许多自然和历史景点。除了上面提到的，全国各地还有许多旅游景点。
lines.rw: Ahantu nyaburanga na ndangamateka mu Rwanda ni henshi. Uretse hariya havuzwe hari n'ahandi hirya no hino mu Gihugu.
lines.en: Rwanda has so many natural and historical sites. Except those above, there are also many tourist sites all over the country.

lines.zh: 在卢旺达，最常被参观的旅游景点是国家公园（火山国家公园、阿卡盖拉国家公园、纽恩威国家公园）、湖泊（基伍湖、穆哈齐湖、布雷拉湖和鲁洪多湖）、洞穴（穆桑泽）和天然森林（吉什瓦蒂）。
lines.rw: Ahantu nyaburanga hasurwa cyane mu Rwanda ni amapariki (Pariki y'Ibirunga, iy'Akagera, iya Nyungwe), ibiyaga (Kivu, Muhazi, Burera na Ruhondo), ubuvumo (Musanze) n'amashyamba kimeza (Gishwati).
lines.en: In Rwanda, the most visited touristic sites are National Parks (Volcanoes, Akagera, Nyungwe), lakes (Kivu, Muhazi, Burera and Ruhondo), caves (Musanze) and natural forests (Gishwati).
lines.tts: Ahantu nyaburanga hasurwa cyane mu Rwanda ni amapariki Pariki y'Ibirunga, iy'Akagera, iya Nyungwe, ibiyaga Kivu, Muhazi, Burera na Ruhondo, ubuvumo Musanze n'amashyamba kimeza Gishwati.

lines.zh: 我去见朱鲁。明天学校就要开学了。
lines.rw: Ngiye kureba Juru kuko ejo tuzatangira amasomo.
lines.en: I am going to see Juru. Tomorrow is the start of the school year.

lines.zh: 你们开学这么早！你妈妈康复了吗？
lines.rw: Aka kanya se muratangiye! Ese nyoko yarakize?
lines.en: But, your back-to-school comes early! Did your mother recover?

lines.zh: 康复了，她吃了对症的药，现在可以轻松走路了。
lines.rw: Yego, yanyoye imiti ikwiye, ubu ashobora kugenda nta kibazo.
lines.en: Yes. She took adequate medicines and she can walk easily now.

lines.zh: 我会的。你什么时候来看她？
lines.en: I will do so. When will you come to greet her?

lines.zh: 我要回医院了。我哥哥病了，他刚做了手术。他康复后我再来。
lines.rw: Mukuru wange ari kwa muganga, nsubiyeyo. Baramubaze nzaza yakize.
lines.en: I am going back to hospital. My elder brother is ill; he has endured a surgery operation. I will come after his recovery.

你（Wowe / You）
他/她（We / He, She）
我们（Twe, twebwe / We）

他们/她们（Bo / They）
在卢旺达语中，动词不定式的开头是 gu-、ku-、ko- 和 kwa-，如 gusohoka（出去）、kubabara（受苦）、kongera（增加）、kwangiza（破坏）。正如这些例子所示，不定式总是以元音 -a 结尾。主要的动词时态有：现在时、将来时和过去时。

lines.zh: 我想请你来帮我们筹备派对。
lines.rw: Ndashaka ko uza tukajyana mu myiteguro y'ibirori byacu.
lines.en: I want you to join us in our party preparations.

lines.zh: 那么你也不能来参加派对吗？
lines.rw: None se no mu birori ntuzaboneka?
lines.en: Won't you be with us in the party?

lines.zh: 我去不了。我要带加特西去医院。
lines.rw: Oya, sinzaboneka. Nzajyana Gatesi kwa muganga.
lines.en: No, I won't. I will take Gatesi to hospital.

lines.zh: 甚至连晚上你都没空吗？
lines.rw: Ubwo se na nimugoroba ntabwo uzahagera?
lines.en: Even in the evening you won't be there?

lines.zh: 是的。我们要在医院过夜。
lines.en: No. We will spend the night to the hospital.

lines.zh: 哦！我们的派对不能没有你啊！
lines.rw: Yooo! Ndababaye kuba tutazifatanya muri biriya birori.
lines.en: Oh! It's hard to miss you in our party!

lines.zh: 顺便说一下，你们可以第二天来看我们。
lines.en: By the way, you can come and visit us the following day.

lines.rw: Yego di! Tuzaza nyuma ya saa sita.
lines.en: Yes! We will come in the afternoon.
Thanks for having agreed to come.
we will spend the night there
the next day; the following day
the next day; the following day
thank you for having agreed to come

lines.note: 在卢旺达语中表示拒绝时，你可以使用这些词：
表示接受时，你可以使用这些词：

lines.zh: 人体有三个主要部分：头部，躯干，手臂和腿。
lines.rw: Umubiri w'umuntu ugizwe n'ibice bitatu: umutwe, igihimba, amaboko n'amaguru.
lines.en: Human body has three main parts: the head, the trunk, the arms and the legs.

lines.zh: 头部有额头，眼睛，鼻子，嘴，下巴，脸颊，耳朵，后颈，脖子。
lines.rw: Ku mutwe hari agahanga, amaso, izuru, umunwa, akananwa, amatama, amatwi, irugu n'ijosi.
lines.en: The head has: the forehead, the eyes, the nose, the mouth, the chin, the cheeks, the ears, the nape of the neck, the neck.

lines.zh: 躯干上有肚脐，乳房，肚子，背和胸部。
lines.rw: Ku gihimba hari umukondo, amabere, inda, umugongo n'igituza.
lines.en: On the trunk we find the navel, the breasts, the belly, the back, and the chest.

lines.zh: 手臂上有前臂，手指，指甲，手肘，手腕和手。
lines.rw: Ku maboko hari ikizigira, intoki, inzara, inkokora, ubujana n'ibiganza.
lines.en: On the arms there are the arm, the fingers, the nails, the elbows, the wrists and the hands.

lines.zh: 腿上有脚，脚趾，脚后跟，脚踝，膝盖和大腿。
lines.rw: Ku maguru hari ibirenge, amano, agatsinsino, akagumbambari, ivi n'ikibero.
lines.en: On the legs there are the feet, the toes, the heel, the ankle, the knee, and the thigh.

lines.zh: 谁能告诉我们身体的各个部位？
lines.rw: Ni nde watubwira ibice bigize umubiri wacu?
lines.en: Who can tell us the parts of the body?
What are the other parts they didn't mention?

lines.zh: 额头，眼睛，鼻子，嘴，耳朵，脸颊，下巴。
lines.rw: Agahanga, amaso, izuru, umunwa, amatwi, amatama, akananwa.
lines.en: The forehead, the eyes, the nose, the mouth, the ears, the cheek, the chin.

lines.zh: 脖子，肩膀，腋窝，肚子，背，肚脐，胸，乳房和臀部。
lines.rw: Ijosi, ibitugu, ukwaha, inda, umugongo, umukondo, igituza, amabere n'ikibuno.
lines.en: The neck, the shoulders, armpits, the stomach, the back, the navel, the chest, the breast and the buttocks.

lines.zh: 你们不知道身体的其他部位了吗？
lines.en: Don't you know any other parts of the body?
The hand, the fingers and the nails.
The knees, the feet and the toes.

lines.rw: Ni mu birori by'umunsi mpuzamahanga wahariwe kurwanya SIDA

lines.en: There is many people in these ceremonies.

lines.zh: 我看到了很多医生和护士。
lines.en: I saw many doctors and nurses.

lines.zh: 你没看到受邀的老师和农学家有多少吗！
lines.rw: Ko utavuga abarimu n'abagoronome batumiwe ukuntu ari benshi!
lines.en: Didn't you see how many are the invited teachers and agronomists!

lines.zh: 我和我们省的会计还有他的警察邻居一起来的。
lines.rw: Nazanye n'umubaruramari w'intara yacu n'umuporisi baturanye.
lines.en: I came here with our province accountant and his neighbor who is a policeman.

lines.zh: 那个人是我们区的兽医，旁边那个人是检察官。很明显这些仪式会很有趣。
lines.rw: Uriya we ni umuveterineri w'Akarere kacu, naho uwo bahagararanye ni umushinjacyaha. Urabona ko ibi birori biri buryohe.
lines.en: That man is our District vet (veterinarian) and that one near him is a prosecutor. Obviously, these ceremonies will be entertaining.

lines.zh: 将会有摩托车手和学生的游行。但我不知道是否会有足球比赛。
lines.rw: Hari bube akarasisi k'abamotari n'abanyeshuri! Ariko sinzi niba hari umupira uri bube.
lines.en: There will be a motorcyclists and students’ parade. But I don't know if there will be a football match.

lines.zh: 会有足球赛的。你没看到裁判和球员走进更衣室吗？我们看完再走吧。
lines.rw: Umupira uraba. Ntiwabonye abasifuzi n'abakinnyi binjira mu rwambariro? Tuze kuwureba dutahe urangiye.
lines.en: Yes! There will be a football match. Didn't you see the referees and the players getting into the dressing room?

lines.zh: 卢旺达的专业人士包括农民、护士、木匠、老师、摩托车手、裁缝、店主等。
lines.rw: Abanyamyuga baboneka mu Rwanda barimo abahinzi borozi, abaforomo, ababaji, abarimu, abamotari, abadozi, abacuruzi n'abandi.
lines.en: Among professionals found in Rwanda are farmers, nurses, carpenters, teachers, motocyclists, tailors, shopkeepers, etc.

lines.zh: 我们有胡萝卜、四季豆、茄子、西红柿、卷心菜和洋葱。
lines.rw: Dufite karoti, imiteja, intoryi, inyanya, amashu n'ibitunguru.
lines.en: We have carrots, French beans, eggfruits, tomatoes, cabbages and onions.

lines.zh: 除了这些木瓜，你还有其他水果吗？
lines.rw: Nta zindi mbuto mufite uretse aya mapapayi?
lines.en: Do you have any other fruits except these papayas?

lines.zh: 我们还有牛油果、百香果、李子、柠檬、橘子、熟香蕉和芒果。
lines.rw: Dufite na voka, amatunda, ibinyomoro, indimu, amacunga, imineke n'imyembe.
lines.en: We do also have avocados, passion fruits, plums, lemons, oranges, ripe bananas and mangoes.

lines.zh: 我要两公斤茄子和三公斤西红柿。然后再给我四公斤百香果和一公斤李子。我该付多少钱？
lines.rw: Ndifuza ibiro bibiri by'intoryi na bitatu by'inyanya. Hanyuma imbuto zo, murampa ibiro bine by'amatunda, ikiro k'ibinyomoro. Ni angahe?
lines.en: I need two kilos of eggfruits and three kilos of tomatoes. You give me four kilos of passion fruits and one kilo of plums. How much have I to pay?

lines.zh: 两公斤茄子四百卢郎，三公斤西红柿一千二百卢郎。一公斤百香果一千卢郎，一公斤李子一千四百卢郎。总价是四千卢郎。
lines.rw: Ibiro bibiri by'intoryi ni amafaranga magana ane, naho ibiro bitatu by'inyanya ni igihumbi na magana abiri. Ikiro cy'amatunda ni igihumbi, ik'ibinyomoro ni igihumbi na magana ane. Byose hamwe ni ibihumbi bine.
lines.en: Two kilos of eggfruits' price are four hundred, and three kilos of tomatoes' price is one thousand two hundred. One kilo of passion fruits' price is one thousand, one kilo of plums' price is one thousand and four hundred. The total price is four thousand.

lines.zh: 太贵了！百香果和李子能便宜点吗？
lines.rw: Ko ari menshi ku matunda n'ibinyomoro wankaturiye?
lines.en: It's too much! Would you like to reduce the passion fruits and plums' price?

lines.zh: 水果的话，我每公斤减两百卢郎。所以，水果你付两千就行了。
lines.rw: Ku mbuto, ndakaturaho magana abiri kuri buri kiro. Ubwo urampa ibihumbi bibiri.
lines.en: I drop two hundred francs per kilo of fruits. Then, you pay two thousand for fruits.

lines.note: 注意在卢旺达，人们在市场买东西必须讨价还价。没有固定价格。买卖双方总是要经过谈判才能达成一致。
在卢旺达语中，像 gushaka、kwifuza、gukenera 这样的动词都表示需求，在这种情况下的含义相近。例如：

lines.zh: 我冷，我需要/想要一件毛衣。
他们来了，他们需要/想吃点东西休息一下。
卢旺达市场有许多产品：
lines.rw: Ku isoko mu Rwanda haba ibicuruzwa byinshi

lines.zh: 蔬菜：卷心菜，胡萝卜，西红柿，洋葱等。
lines.rw: Imboga: amashu, karoti, inyanya, ibitunguru, n'izindi.
lines.en: Vegetables: cabbages, carrots, tomatoes, onions, etc.

lines.zh: 水果：木瓜，橘子，柠檬，芒果，番石榴等。
lines.rw: Imbuto: amapapayi, amacunga, indimu, imyembe, amapera, n'izindi.
lines.en: Fruits: papayas, oranges, lemons, mangoes, guavas, etc.

lines.zh: 其他食品：豆类，土豆，红薯，面粉，盐，油，大米，糖，香蕉等。
lines.rw: Ibiribwa bindi: ibishyimbo, ibirayi, ibijumba, ifu, umunyu, amavuta, umuceri, isukari, ibitoki, n'ibindi.
lines.en: Other foods: beans, round potatoes, sweet potatoes, flour, salt, oil, rice, sugar, bananas, etc.

lines.zh: 告诉我，我该为我的新家买些什么家居用品？
lines.rw: Mbwira ibikoresho byo mu rugo nagura byo gushyira mu nzu yange nshya.
lines.en: I want you to tell me what are the equipment that I can buy for my new house?

lines.zh: 你可以买桌子、椅子、橱柜、床和床垫。
lines.rw: Buriya wagura ameza, intebe, akabati, ibitanda n'amagodora.
lines.en: You can buy tables, chairs, cupboard, beds and mattresses.

lines.zh: 把你能想到的都告诉我。
lines.en: Tell me everything you can remember.

lines.zh: 你还可以买盘子、汤碗、叉子、勺子、杯子、保温瓶、窗帘、床单和毯子。
lines.rw: Wagura kandi amasahani, ibisuperi, amakanya, ibiyiko, ibikombe, teremusi, amarido, amashuka n'uburingiti.
lines.en: You can buy also plates, soup tureens, forks, spoons, cups, vacuum flasks, curtains, sheets and blankets.

lines.zh: 我不需要买厨房用具吗？
lines.en: Shouldn't I buy also kitchen equipments?

lines.zh: 你要买汤锅、平底锅、火炉、长柄勺和菜刀。
lines.rw: Uzagure amasafuriya, ipanu, imbabura, imidaho n'ibyuma.
lines.en: You will buy saucepans, pans, braziers, ladles and kitchen knives.

lines.zh: 既然你知道我家的空间有多大，你觉得我能养些什么家畜？
lines.rw: Ese ko uzi iwange uko hangana, urabona nahororera ayahe matungo?
lines.en: As you know my home space, what kind of farm animals can I breed?

lines.zh: 你可以养牛、山羊、母鸡和兔子。
lines.rw: Ushobora kuhororera inka, ihene, inkoko n'inkwavu.
lines.en: You can breed cows, goats, hens and rabbits.

lines.zh: 我更倾向于只养猪和母鸡。
lines.rw: Yewe nge mbona nakorora gusa ingurube n'inkoko.
lines.en: I prefer to breed only pigs and hens.

lines.zh: 是的，它们很有经济效益。
家畜：卢旺达人喜欢养牛、山羊、母鸡、猪、兔子和绵羊。
lines.rw: Amatungo: Abanyarwanda bakunda korora inka, ihene, inkoko, ingurube, inkwavu n'intama.
lines.en: Farm animals: Rwandans like to breed cows, goats, hens, pigs, rabbits and sheeps.

lines.zh: 家居用品：桌子、橱柜、椅子、床、床垫、床单、毯子、盘子、叉子、勺子、杯子、刀、汤锅、长柄勺和汤碗。
lines.rw: Ibikoresho: Ameza, utubati, intebe, ibitanda, amagodora, amashuka, ibiringiti, amasahani, amakanya, ibiyiko, ibikombe, ibyuma, amasafuriya, imidaho n' ibisuperi.
lines.en: Home equipment: tables, cupboards, chairs, beds, mattresses, sheets, blankets, plates, forks, spoons, cups, knives, saucepans, ladles and soup tureens.

lines.zh: 我觉得不舒服，我来看病。
lines.en: I don't feel good! I am coming for medical check.
Have a seat. How are you feeling?

lines.zh: 我昨天开始发烧，咳嗽，头痛，恶心还拉肚子！
lines.rw: Mpinda umuriro kuva ejo, ndakorora, ndibwa umutwe, mfite iseseme ndetse nshibwamo!
lines.en: I have a fever since yesterday; I have got cough, headache, nausea and diarrhea.
Haven't you ever got any medicine?

lines.zh: 好吧。我去给你开单子去实验室化验。你有医疗保险吗？
lines.rw: Reka nkwandikire uge kuri raboratwari gutanga ibizamini. Ukoresha ubwishingizi bw'ubuzima?
lines.en: Right! Go to laboratory for tests. Do you have any health insurance?

lines.rw: Yego. Kuri raboratwari ni ahagana he?
lines.en: Yes, I do. Where is the laboratory?

lines.zh: 出门右转，到了儿科那里问一下护士，她会告诉你的。
lines.rw: Urasohoka utambike iburyo, nugera hariya ku bitaro by'abana ubaze umuforomo uhari arahakwereka.
lines.en: After getting out, you turn right and when you reach paediatrics ask the nurse where the labo is located.
Will I directly get the results?

lines.zh: 不能。你需要等化验，结果出来后你拿给我看，我再给你开药，然后你去药房买。
lines.rw: Oya. Urategereza bapime, igisubizo nikiboneka urakinzanira ndebe indwara babonye hanyuma nkwandikire imiti uge kuyigura muri farumasi.
lines.en: No. You'll wait for tests and analysis, by after you come back with the results for further medication prescription. And then you will go to buy medicines in the pharmacy.
I am going to give you an injection
You are going to give urine sample
You need to have a blood test
I have a headache and a stomachache

lines.note: 在卢旺达常见的疾病有：疟疾、腹泻、肝炎、胃病、呼吸道疾病。
在卢旺达，人们在以下机构获得医疗服务：村级卫生所、卫生中心、医院、转诊医院、教学医院以及私立诊所和医院。
医疗人员包括医生（全科医生和专科医生）、护士、助产士、麻醉师、牙医。
卢旺达有许多售药商店，由卫生部注册的专业药剂师管理。
在卢旺达，医疗保险服务很发达。有不同种类的医疗保险，如互助医疗保险、公职人员医疗保险、军队医疗保险以及其他私人医疗保险服务。
